says_a: 'Vertical diffusion acts on the whole column... That it is the cause is an inference.'
says_b: 'E42b falsifies the inference... vertical diffusion does not make it, and the inference E42 drew was wrong.'

topic: E35's first-quoted 'form A without the repair' value
says_a: Quoted 54.9 J/kg for 'form A with the repair's ledgers taken back out', concluding the clamp is at most part of C9's gap.
says_b: The ledgers are not transported, so subtracting them does not give form A without the repair; corrected reading is off by up to 22.0 J/kg against C9, 219 under tracer transport.

topic: R9's moisture coefficient for the C1 reference shift
says_a: First gave c(q) = q_d*cp_d + q_v*cp_v + q_l*cp_l + q_i*cp_i, 1021.6 J/kg/K at q_tot=0.02, spread 1.7%.
says_b: Corrected: every water phase moves by cp_l*|delta|, so c(q) = (1-q_tot)*cp_d + q_tot*cp_l, 1068.0 J/kg/K at q_tot=0.02, spread 6.3%.

topic: E52 vs E56: does the fork build the EDMF column more slowly than upstream
says_a: 'With no diagnostic on, the fork builds the EDMF column in 635s where upstream takes 249s. The difference is in building the tendency function.'
says_b: 'The fork does not build the EDMF column more slowly than upstream. E52's gap is where the compile is counted' -- both spend ~400s compiling the same Jacobian solver; upstream's compile falls outside the timed block.

topic: E68's updraft-gap reading (V3, before the mixing convention was accounted for)
says_a: L1 of psi-q_gas_A: 7.8% at 1h falling to 3.2% at 24h, read as the updraft gap alone.
says_b: 'The premise is wrong': the region tags have no sources, so new energy is attributed by mask, which the tracer does not do; with updraft copies (E73) the gap alone in the boundary layer is 0.3 points at 6h and 1.3 points at 24h, much smaller than E68's raw number.

topic: E69's third point (is the sphere's residual the solver's)
says_a: 'On the sphere the converged twin does not close better... So the sphere's residual is not the one-iteration solve's. It is the explicit processes the tags do not yet follow, and Float32.'
says_b: 'The third point's explanation is wrong. With two iterations the sphere's residual is Float32 rounding alone (E70).'

topic: The updraft-gap-bound script's headline percentages
doc_a: OPERATIONAL_TODO.md 'On the way to G2' / UPDRAFT_GAP.md
says_a: "In the tropics the gap would move 15 to 30% a day of the surface-sourced tags... elsewhere under 4%" (from updraft_gap_bound.jl's upwind reconstruction).
says_b: The upwind reconstruction zeroes the gap at the face carrying the most mass flux (finding W1); under the model's own centred reconstruction, net relocation is 46% and 27% for sfc (not 15-30%), and 'elsewhere under 4%' does not hold (9-51% under centred, finding W2/M1-M6).

topic: Whether a converged Newton twin measures the per-tag error of one-iteration solves on V2 (G2, first run)
doc_a: OPERATIONAL_TODO.md G1 'On the way to G2'
says_a: g2_v2_sphere_newton10 is described as the twin whose per-tag numbers should be compared against V2's one-iteration run.
says_b: 'The twin cannot measure the per-tag error of one iteration here. The atmospheres differ by 4K at the top already at 1h... The two-iteration rerun, whose top follows the twin's, is the one to compare' -- i.e. g2_v2_sphere_n2, not the raw one-iteration g2_v2_sphere, is the comparable run.

topic: D4's residual size under the enthalpy audit, base run (E53 vs E59)
says_a: d4_column_edmf_enthalpy gross_residual 5.41e5 J/m2 at 24h (gross_relative 4.7e-3), from ClimaCore 0.16 / upstream v0.42.9-era code.
says_b: c1c_base_d4_enthalpy (the 'main, tags diffuse as tracers' baseline used for the C1c comparison) gives 6.32e5 J/m2 at 24h, 17% above E53's number, 'because E53 ran before #89, with ClimaCore 0.16 and upstream v0.42.9's model, so the two atmospheres differ' -- a code/version difference, not a contradiction, but the two headline D4-baseline residuals differ by 17% and should not be quoted interchangeably.
